answer_1.quote: We directly prompt GPT-4 to simulate a patient's next response in a dialogue ... as early testing revealed that this can mitigate role consistency issues.

answer_3.quote: The LLM (a) evaluates whether the questions are applicable to the context and the answers to the principle‑adherence questions; and (b) refines the response to ideally receive YES on all questions.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a within‑subjects study with 25 counseling experts... Counselors rated the two AI patients based on 6 dimensions.
answer_4.guideline: 7‑point Likert scale on dimensions such as authenticity, stayed in role, resembled past case, typical case, challenged counselor, ready as training partner, recommend to novices.
